subject: an ocher arcade intersecting a single blue diagonal wall
art_direction: 赭色连续拱面与蓝色斜墙构成抽象建筑景观，暖光和上方奶白留空精简有力。
visible_description: 赭色连续拱面与蓝色斜墙构成抽象建筑景观，暖光和上方奶白留空精简有力。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create an ocher arcade intersecting a single blue diagonal wall. Use three broad arches rather than a long repeated corridor. The blue wall cuts across the lower right, casting one crisp shadow through the nearest opening. Keep the upper fifth as a plain warm sky plane. Add no windows, figures, or text; the relationship of solid and void should carry the wallpaper. Use hard-edge architectural abstraction. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
